title: SQL Injection in user lookup
description: The lookupUser handler concatenates the raw `id` query parameter into a SQL string, allowing an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL. Sending `id=1 OR 1=1` returns every user row.
root_cause: lookupUser in src/handlers/user.js does not parameterize the id query parameter, allowing SQL injection.
intended_behavior: The endpoint should return the single user whose primary key equals the supplied id.

trace.description: req.query.id enters from the HTTP request without validation.
The concatenated string is executed directly against the database.

evidence.description: rawQuery passes the concatenated string to db.query without binding parameters.

execution.attacker_perspective: An unauthenticated remote user with network access to the public API.
instructions: Call lookupUser from a local harness against a dummy database seeded with two users, passing id=1 OR 1=1.
Compare the returned rows with the single requested id.
execution.observed_result: The harness returned both dummy user rows instead of the single requested id.

remediation.strategy: Use a parameterized query so the id value is bound rather than concatenated.

likelihood.reason: The endpoint is publicly reachable and needs no authentication.

impact.reason: Full read access to the users table, including credentials.

confidence.reason: The vulnerable concatenation and its execution sink were both read directly in source.

title: Upload size may be unbounded
description: The upload handler buffers the whole request body; whether a size limit applies depends on proxy configuration that is not in the repository.
claimed_root_cause: handleUpload reads the full body into memory without an application-level size check.

trace.description: The request body is read in full before any size check.

evidence.description: No size limit is passed to the body reader.

blockers: The reverse-proxy body-size configuration is absent from this checkout.

validation_plan.local: Run handleUpload in a sandboxed harness with a body just above the documented limit and record whether it is rejected.

title: XSS in renderComment
description: The candidate claimed renderComment writes comment text into the page unescaped.
claimed_root_cause: renderComment was claimed to interpolate comment.body without escaping.

trace.description: comment.body is interpolated into the template.

evidence.description: The interpolation uses the auto-escaping template helper.

reason: The template engine auto-escapes all interpolated values, and no raw-output helper is used on that path.
